releaseNotes:
<!--LANG:en-->
A33 Studio 2.2.0

- New Video page in the sidebar: describe a scene and get a 5–15 s video, with an up-front cost estimate. Videos are saved by date to Documents/A33 Studio/视频.
- Image is now its own page: each message generates or edits an image directly, with reference images by upload or paste.
- Gallery moved from the sidebar to the launchpad.
- Chat can draw out of the box: ask for a picture in any conversation (turn it off from the 生图 toggle under the input).
- Image page: options for model, size and 1–4 images; copy, download or show any result in its folder; one-click regenerate.
- Advanced image mode moved into the Image page (高级模式 button).
<!--LANG:zh-CN-->
A33 Studio 2.2.0

- 左侧栏新增「生视频」：描述画面即可生成 5～15 秒视频，生成前显示预计费用；视频按日期保存到 文档/A33 Studio/视频。
- 生图改为独立页面：每句话直接生成或修改图片，可上传或粘贴参考图。
- 图库从左侧栏移到启动台。
- 对话里可以直接让 AI 画图（输入框下的「生图」开关可关闭）。
- 生图页新增参数：模型、尺寸、一次 1～4 张；结果图可复制、下载、在文件夹中显示，一键重新生成。
- 高级生图移到生图页右上角「高级模式」。
<!--LANG:END-->

<!--LANG:en-->
A33 Studio 2.1.9

- The sidebar now shows Chat, Image, Gallery, Translate, Files, Notes, Code and Agents for upgraded installs too.
<!--LANG:zh-CN-->
A33 Studio 2.1.9

- 升级后的客户端左侧栏也会显示：对话、生图、图库、翻译、文件、笔记、代码工具、智能体。
<!--LANG:END-->

<!--LANG:en-->
A33 Studio 2.1.8

- Image generation is now a conversation: describe a picture, then keep asking for changes.
- New Gallery: generated images are saved by date to Documents/A33 Studio/图 and browsable in the app.
- Enter your A33 key once and models, defaults and image generation are configured automatically.
- In-app updates from a33.club.
<!--LANG:zh-CN-->
A33 Studio 2.1.8

- 生图改为对话式：描述画面后可以连续追问修改。
- 新增图库：生成的图片按日期保存到 文档/A33 Studio/图，可在应用内浏览。
- 填一次 A33 Key，模型、默认设置和生图自动配置好。
- 支持在客户端内一键更新。
<!--LANG:END-->
